## Booking Holdings Inc. to Present at the Nasdaq 55th Investor Conference


November 24, 2026


NORWALK, Conn.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) today announced that Chief Financial Officer Ewout Steenbergen will speak at the Nasdaq 55th Investor Conference, held in association with Morgan Stanley in London, on December 8, beginning at 6:30 am ET / 11:30 am GMT. A live audio cast of the presentation will be available to the public at[https://ir.bookingholdings.com/events](https://ir.bookingholdings.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx) . A replay will be available approximately 24 hours later and will remain available for 12 months.


Source: Booking Holdings
#BKNG_Corporate


**About Booking Holdings** Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and services that support the entire travel journey. Our platforms - including[Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/) ,[Priceline](https://www.priceline.com/) ,[Agoda](https://www.agoda.com/) ,[KAYAK](https://www.kayak.com/) and[OpenTable](https://www.opentable.com/) - utilize advanced AI, machine learning and other innovative technologies to simplify and personalize the travel experience for consumers and partners in over 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit[BookingHoldings.com](http://bookingholdings.com/) and follow us on X @BookingHoldings.
